# Team Organization

The Cherry Bombs coding team has a flat hierarchy. Please defer to Kayo (Maintainer, BDFL), who just serves to help out with organization between team members. 

# Before You Start

To save you time, for anything more than a *minor* change, à la editing Wikipedia, please open an issue before you start sinking time into this. Someone else could already be working on it, or the maintainer could do it quicker. It's also likely that discussions with the rest of the development team will be needed. Our role isn't to *just code*, we manage, plan, and design systems. This means that philosophical stuff may need to be sorted out first, given this isn't a solo project. Unless directed or otherwise ran by the maintainer it's ill-advised to start writing code straight away. 

# On Branches

Please don't push to main, nor make a force push. You will need to contribute under another branch and make a pull request. If you do not know how to do this, please **talk** with the rest of the team. Running `git add -A; git commit; git push -f origin main` is how you get demoted to using Discord as an IDE, and needing to ask the other team members to submit code for you.

# The Role of a Contributor

It is the contributors role to ensure their pull request is up to date with main. Use the golden rule when coding and such. Please submit things in separate pull requests when possible, as opposed to bundling. For small changes, please don't run `git commit -a`. For large changes (where it is impractical for the maintainer to review all changes), please submit your shell history, and describe all actions you took. Once you submit the pull request, it will be reviewed by the maintainer, who may accept it, request changes, have a discussion instead, or close the pull request.
